statement: RF240 remodeling is modestly associated with the magnitude of phenotype-state remodeling in persistent Bassez clonotypes.
The clone-level association is robust across QC thresholds.
At patient level, the association is directionally positive among E-classified patients.
Patient-level effect magnitude is stable across nested QC choices.
The association is significantly stronger in E than NE.
State-changing clonotypes have significantly greater RF240 remodeling than state-stable clonotypes.
Both Bassez cohorts independently replicate the effect.
